title: Search for target objects on countertops before checking cabinets
description: Use this when looking for common household items like mugs that are often placed on visible surfaces.
content: When searching for a mug or similar everyday object, check countertops and other open surfaces first, as they are frequently placed there rather than inside closed cabinets.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some mug and put it in coffeemachine.

title: Locate target object by checking multiple storage surfaces
description: Use this when the target object is not visible in the current location and multiple similar storage locations exist.
content: When searching for an object, systematically visit each plausible storage surface (e.g., shelves, tables) and inspect the listed objects. The target object may be on a different surface than the first one checked.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a statue in sidetable.

title: Cool objects by using the fridge with the object in hand
description: Use this when a task requires cooling an object that is not already inside a fridge.
content: To cool an item, first pick it up, then go to the fridge and use the "cool [object] with [fridge]" action while holding it.
